name: Comparison
description: Compare products side by side, one category at a time: a button on every card and product page, a counter in the header, a table of characteristics with "differences only". Kept for the visit, in the session.

settings.label: A comparison button on catalogue cards
settings.help: In the photograph's corner, under the heart; on which devices — the theme's settings, "Product cards". On the product page it is always there.

options.category: By category: a tab per category
options.category_all: By category, plus an "All together" tab

settings.label: How the comparison page groups products
settings.help: A laptop beside a phone case is a table of dashes, so products are compared by their deepest category, a tab each. The "All together" tab puts everything a visitor has collected into one table when they want that anyway. "All together" alone drops the categories, and the limit below then counts every product.

settings.label: Products of one category compared at once
settings.help: Adding one more pushes out the one added first, and the notice says which. Past four the columns no longer fit a screen.

settings.label: A notice in the corner when a product is added
